encumbrance_system.description: How much you can carry. Capacity = Strength × base_weight_multiplier pounds, plus what worn containers add (a backpack +25 lb). The load tiers and their penalties are the encumbrance-* effects (game-data/effects), each applied by its system_check on weight_percent: Light Load at 34% or less, Overweight over 100%, Encumbered over 150%, Overloaded over 200%.
